soundcore - by anker p40i noise cancelin.description: Discover the soundcore by Anker P40i Noise Cancelling Wireless Earbuds, your ultimate companion for immersive audio experiences on the go. With adaptive ANC technology, these earbuds automatically detect ambient noise and use advanced algorithms to cancel it out, ensuring tranquility wherever you are. Enjoy an impressive 60-hour playtime on a single charge, complete with a 2-in-1 case that doubles as a phone stand for hands-free viewing. Featuring 11mm composite drivers and BassUp° technology, the P40i delivers powerful bass and immersive soundscapes. With six built-in microphones and an AI algorithm, crystal-clear call quality is guaranteed. Plus, multipoint connectivity and IPX5 water resistance make these earbuds adaptable to any lifestyle, providing a seamless audio experience in any weather condition. Upgrade your sound with the Soundcore P40i and enjoy music as it's meant to be heard.

Built-in magnets snap your phone securely in place, ensuring stable charging on bumpy roads while enabling one-handed mount and release for safer hands-free driving. The 360° rotatable vent mount lets you position your phone perfectly for navigation, calls, or music.
